meta.rule: Items here are never silently corrected. Blank + flagged beats inferred. Every entry links its evidence.

flags.title: Initial repository contained only a 6-byte README
flags.detail: At base commit 6c3004d the entire tree was README.md containing exactly '# NBA3' (6 bytes, verified with od -c). No LICENSE, no .gitignore, no CI, no docs, no code. Any statement that this repo previously contained analysis or pick logic would be false.
flags.status: OPEN - README expanded in this branch; LICENSE/.gitignore decisions logged in QUESTIONS.md Q-07/Q-08

flags.title: Commit author identities differ across history
flags.detail: Initial commit author email is a personal gmail address; subsequent commits use the noreply github address. Timestamps also differ in timezone offset (+0900 vs +0000). Not an integrity problem (all commits are the repo owner) but recorded for audit completeness.

flags.title: nba.com/standings returns no standings table to non-JS fetch
flags.detail: Official standings page renders table content client-side only; fetch returned tiebreak procedures text but no team rows. Records were therefore harvested from nba.com game pages + nba.com/stats league table instead (both official, cross-checked: all 31 slate rows match).
flags.status: RESOLVED via alternate official sources; standings page remains unusable for automation

flags.title: Undefined 'R' flag in official schedule PDF legend
flags.detail: Game 40 (GSW at SAS, 11/13) carries an 'R' flag in the NOTE column alongside the Cup 'C' flag. The official legend on the final PDF page defines C (Cup), A (Austin), B (Mexico City), D (Paris), E (Manchester) but never R. Meaning not inferred. Same R flag appears on other rows (e.g., game 27 PHI@CLE, game 50 HOU@DEN).
evidence: schedule PDF chunk 1 rows for games 27/40
flags.status: OPEN - flagged, not inferred; ask NBA source owner (Q-05)

flags.title: Observed injury-report posting times do not match documented cadence
flags.detail: official.nba.com relaunch documentation states reports post daily at 1:30/5:30/8:30 p.m. ET. Reports observed on 2026-11-13 were stamped 01:00, 01:15, 04:15 and 05:00 PM ET. The documented cadence may be stale; observed timestamps are used for freshness gates.
evidence: 4 report PDFs fetched with distinct timestamp filenames
flags.status: OPEN - freshness gates use observed timestamps

flags.title: 11/14 teams partially NOT YET SUBMITTED; 11/15-16 reports not published
flags.detail: In the latest official report (05:00 PM 11/13), DEN, NOP, CLE, MEM, CHI, MIN and MIA rows for 11/14 read 'NOT YET SUBMITTED'. No rows exist for any 11/15 or 11/16 game. All affected pick rows are PROVISIONAL: model lines generated from team strength + rest only, injury input blank, never scored until a report covering that date exists.
flags.status: OPEN - pipeline re-runs when newer report publishes (Q-01)

flags.title: Blank team cell on page-break row (Williams, Brandon)
flags.detail: PDF page break left the team column empty on the 'Williams, Brandon - Out - Left Hamstring Strain' row in the GSW@SAS block. Attributed to GSW because the GSW roster lists Brandon Williams #12 (10.4 PPG) and the SAS roster contains no such player. Attribution recorded rather than treated as certain.
flags.status: OPEN - attribution documented, confidence high but not official

flags.title: MIL OPPG rounding mismatch (121.3 direct vs 121.4 derived)
flags.detail: Direct OPPG on the official MIL team page is 121.3; PTS(106.8) - margin(-14.6) derives 121.4. 0.1 rounding difference between two official renderings. Direct value used; derived cross-check recorded.

flags.title: DET@MIA (11/14) TV: PDF blank vs NBA TV on nba.com
flags.detail: Schedule PDF row 233 national-TV column is empty; nba.com/schedule shows the NBA TV logo for this game. Page treated as more current than the August PDF; both recorded.
flags.status: OPEN - discrepancy logged, page value used for display

flags.title: Schedule PDF rows 215+ lose the 'at' separator (column merge)
flags.detail: From PDF row 215 onward the 'at' token is concatenated into the away-team cell (e.g., 'Orlando | at Sacramento'), and rows 246-253 show no 'at' at all. Away/home order was cross-verified for all slate games via nba.com preview URL slugs (away-vs-home) and venue cities; no slate game left ambiguous.
flags.status: RESOLVED for all 31 slate rows via dual-source cross-check; PDF quirk still flagged

flags.title: Player URL slug mismatch: /player/1629027/shai-gilgeous-alexander renders Trae Young
flags.detail: Requesting nba.com/player/1629027/shai-gilgeous-alexander returned the page titled 'Trae Young | Guard | Washington Wizards' (player id 1629027). Canonical URL corrected to nba.com/player/1629027/trae-young. Data used (Trae Young PPG 19.7, WAS) comes from the page that actually rendered. Also confirms Trae Young now plays for WAS in 2026-27 per official page.
evidence: fetched page title 'Trae Young | Guard | Washington Wizards'

flags.title: Live scoreboard JSON and stats API blocked/failed
flags.detail: cdn.nba.com scoreboard JSON returned HTTP 500 (twice); stats.nba.com leaguestandingsv3 fetch failed. No retry per research log. All needed facts obtained from HTML pages and PDFs instead.
flags.status: RESOLVED via alternates; endpoints marked do-not-retry

flags.title: Many OUT players have no verifiable season PPG
flags.detail: G-League/Two-Way assignments and players with GP=0 have PPG '-' on official rosters; some rosters (CHI, HOU, POR, MIA, DAL, BKN, DET) were not fetched in full this session so several OUT players carry season_ppg = null with flag-ppg-missing. Production-at-risk totals for those teams are under-counted by an unknown amount and are labelled INCOMPLETE in injury impact analysis. Never estimated.
flags.status: OPEN - complete by fetching remaining rosters in a later pass (Q-02)

flags.title: Home-court advantage constant (2.5 pts) is an assumption, not an official figure
flags.detail: No official NBA-published HCA value exists in the fetched sources. Location splits exist for only 5 teams (WAS, IND, MIL, ORL, CLE) and show no stable signal in that tiny sample. The model uses +2.5 pts as a flagged assumption; all originated lines carry hca-01. Calibration task logged as Q-03.
flags.status: OPEN - assumption, flagged on every line row

flags.title: Rest penalty and injury PPG weights are model assumptions
flags.detail: b2b_penalty = -1.5 pts and injury_ppg_weight = 0.6 are design constants chosen for v1 of the origination model. They are not derived from official NBA publications. Both are logged as tunable parameters with pre-registered values (no post-hoc edits once picks are scored).

flags.title: official.nba.com/injury-report/ returns 404
flags.detail: The obvious official URL path for injury reports 404s; real reports live at ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/Injury-Report_<date>_<time>.pdf. Pattern confirmed by four working fetches today.
flags.status: RESOLVED - working pattern recorded in sources.json

flags.title: Schedule PDF is an August snapshot marked SUBJECT TO CHANGE
flags.detail: Official PDF header: 'AS OF AUGUST 13, 2026 | SUBJECT TO CHANGE'. All 31 slate rows were re-verified against the live nba.com/schedule page on 2026-11-13 (times, venues, TV, game IDs all match), so current slate data is live-verified; the PDF remains a secondary source.

flags.title: NBA.com schedule page has odds behind 'Hide Odds' toggle but values are client-rendered
flags.detail: The schedule page exposes an odds toggle, but no odds values were present in server-rendered content during this session's fetches. Market odds are therefore NOT captured; CLV (closing-line-value) gates for strategies are explicitly blocked rather than faked.
evidence: nba.com/schedule chunk 0 shows 'Hide Odds' control with no odds values in payload
flags.status: OPEN - market-odds source needed for CLV gates (Q-04)
